scripts.pretest:integration: pnpm --filter @openpeeps/server... build && pnpm --filter @openpeeps/web build && pnpm exec playwright install chromium chromium-headless-shell
scripts.test:integration: if [ -z "$CI" ]; then pnpm run db:clear:test; fi && unset FORCE_COLOR && DB_NAME=test INTEGRATION_SUITE=empty playwright test --project=empty
scripts.test:integration:no-clean: unset FORCE_COLOR && DB_NAME=test INTEGRATION_SUITE=empty playwright test --project=empty
scripts.integration:sso: INTEGRATION_SUITE=sso docker compose -f docker-compose.integration.yml --profile sso up --build --abort-on-container-exit tests
scripts.integration:stack: docker compose -f docker-compose.integration.yml up --build postgres redis mailpit pushcatcher web worker
scripts.integration:stack:default: INTEGRATION_SUITE=default docker compose -f docker-compose.integration.yml up --build postgres redis mailpit pushcatcher restore web worker
scripts.integration:stack:public: INTEGRATION_SUITE=public docker compose -f docker-compose.integration.yml up --build postgres redis mailpit pushcatcher restore web worker
scripts.integration:stack:sso: INTEGRATION_SUITE=sso docker compose -f docker-compose.integration.yml --profile sso up --build postgres redis mailpit pushcatcher oauth restore web worker
scripts.integration:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.integration.yml logs -f web worker
